_comment: THE ONE-WAY DOOR. This is the ONLY human-edited, founder-signed file in the firewall ratchet — it is NOT producer-generated and is NOT byte-diffed by registry-drift. It is the sole exemption to the ratchet GROWTH check: a key listed under _sign_off_additions[gate][code] is exempted, for ONE regen, from the rule that the baseline may only shrink. Growing tolerated debt requires an explicit signed decision here, never a silent producer re-run (founder one-way-door / verify-each-step rule). Keep this tiny and audited. EMPTY = the ratchet is fully closed: the baseline can only shrink.

signings.authorized_by: founder (explicit: 'fully autonomous through both' firewall go-live)
signings.rationale: Admit the firewall's OWN required-CI substrate into the baseline: the oya-ci-required fan-in workflow + its gate-registration meta-test. These are born-unowned/unjustified/unreachable like every other .github workflow + gate test (the RED-but-baselined class), and ADR-0515 makes oya-ci-required the single required GO-LIVE check. Bootstrap exemption — the gate that runs the gates cannot itself pass the accounting gate without this signed admission.
